answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The nebula holds work receipts rather than names, so the garden of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
